headline: Depositing cash at the bank no longer goes unnoticed: even small amounts can raise questions
summary: Depositing large amounts of cash into bank accounts could expose savers to having to show receipts. Even smaller deposits can raise questions, according to the report.
why: Cash deposit reporting rules shape how banks and tax authorities monitor money flows, affecting banking compliance and household cash management.
